one_liner: An unprivileged attacker can extract ~$67 today (dust liquidations of 333 stale-priced accounts); the finding's real danger is latent: one admin unpause of mint+borrow while the oracle stays frozen hands any attacker ~$63-66k in a single tx (fork-verified), not the naive ~$628k cash figure.
